text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, we must think about how it affects people. One key problem is bias: if the data used to train AI is unfair, the AI can make unfair decisions too. Fairness means treating everyone equally, whatever their background. Privacy is also important, because AI systems often collect personal information. Another key idea is transparency: people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means companies and governments must work together to create clear rules. By focusing on these values, we can build AI that helps society and respects everyone's rights.
